director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket-style equal shares se fractions seekhenge. Tumhe cricket pasand hai?
Koi baat nahi, Riya—pasand hona zaroori nahi. Socho, paratha 4 equal tukdon mein baante: tum kitne tukde logi? End mein Golu ko sikhaogi.
Ek roti ko 2 bilkul barabar tukdon mein kaato. Har tukda whole ka half, yani aadha hota hai. Tum ek tukda dikhao.
Haan, dheere chalenge. Equal parts matlab sab tukde same size. Roti ke 2 same tukdon mein, ek tukda kya kehlaayega?
Riya, ek roti ko do barabar hisson mein baanto. Har hissa aadha kehlaata hai. Roti ko do hisson mein baantkar batao: ek hissa kya hai?
Tumne 5 kaha, Riya. Kya tum roti ke 5 tukde keh rahi ho, ya ek hissa ka naam bata rahi ho?
Koi baat nahi. Sahi naam “aadha” hai, kyunki roti 2 barabar hisson mein banti hai. Ab 15 pencils ka 1/3 padhte hain: yeh kya poochta hai?
Socho, ek chocolate ko 3 barabar hisson mein baanta. 1/3 matlab unmein se ek hissa. Ab 12 ka 1/3 tum nikalo.
Pehle har group ki jagah banaao. Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: Riya, tumne 7 kaha. Ab fraction ko dekho: neeche wala number kis baat ki taraf ishara karta hai? Khaali jagah phir bharo.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai Riya, tum aaj rukna chahti ho. Tum keh sakti ho: jaari rakhein, chhota break lein, ya aaj band karein.
